answer: Trust transfers at block 91's stake-lock—the instant an agent bonds collateral to its identity on the jetty of the registry. That collateral sinks below the tide of withdrawal until slashing clears. A spoofer building clones on the upper terrace must post fresh capital per identity; the bond cannot back two agents because the registry burns the deposit reference at first lock. Each sybil duplicate costs full stake. Attack expense scales linearly, never logarithmically.
